title: I Will Work
text: I Will Work. Interesting item.  Kind of weird how it works and folds up. Several of the bottoms of the legs were loose in the box on the one I got. Getting them on was tricky. It will do the job for a plastic piece of crap.

product_metadata.title: Kitchen Pasta Drying Rack Folding, iPstyle Spaghetti Drying Rack Noodle Stand with 10 Bar Handles Green (Drying Rack)
features: 【Food Grade ABS Material】This pasta dryer is made of ABS material, it is good for your health. Do not worry about the food safe problem. Safety and environmental.
【Collapsible and Foldable】10 pcs hanging Arms and each Arm can hold up to 500g pasta,the enough space allow you hang multi pasta. Easily folding and storage.Space saving and easy to use.
【Great Fresh Nooldes Maker Tool 】Ideal for drying a variety of pasta including spaghetti, tagliatelle, fettuccine, vermicelli, linguine & lasagne.
【Easy Clean and Assemble】No screw and tool needed to assemble and disassemble, just use hand to adjust.Easy wipe clean with dry or damp cloth. Sturdy construction with stable base.
【Size Weight and Package】The size is 11*6.6 inches length for each Arm. As it is easy to assemble, so there is no user manual. Net weight: 0.21kg.
